title: Water bubbles chortling
author: stephan
changes: Real recording of big water bubbles (a bottle pushed under water), used for the octopus (octopuses make no sound). Trimmed to 8.10–9.80 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
